annihilator.matrix_per_hand: 12x6 stack of charge-1 and charge-2 Hankel rows
annihilator.uncertainty: paired 400-batch delete-one re-extraction with full projective-residual covariance
annihilator.normalization: candidate-specific shared nonzero coefficient is set to one; that coordinate is omitted from the residual

maps.spatial: identity or Alexander reflection (a,b)->(a,-b), followed by R^k for k=0,1,2,3
maps.primary_family: Alexander reflection plus complex conjugation for all four R^k convention choices
maps.comparators: orientation-preserving R^k, and reflection without coefficient conjugation
maps.deck_invariance: charge relabeling and character phases are invertible row operations and cannot change the common right line

exact_geometry_boundary.interpretation: Alexander is a Hecke-sector bridge hypothesis, not a finite-graph isomorphism

decision_rule: the parameter-free Alexander family is rejected only if all four reflection+conjugation R^k candidates have p<0.01; otherwise report every survivor without selecting by fit quality
